default:spacerVariants:size: `auto` (fill the free space) is the point of a Spacer; the other keys are fixed gaps.
default:timelineIconVariants:color: A timeline dot is neutral until an event earns a tone.
default:ratingFillVariants:color: Filled stars are warning-yellow by convention.
